title: Specialty Espresso Bar
sources: Specialty Coffee Association (SCA) Barista Skills Standards
rules: Always purge steam wand before and after steaming
Steam milk to 60-65°C; never exceed 70°C to avoid scorching
Confirm alternative milks or decaf substitutions before preparing
assumptions: Commercial dual-boiler espresso machine, calibrated conical grinder, fresh dairy and plant milks

stations.name: Conical Grinder
stations.description: Dose and grind fresh coffee beans into portafilter.

stations.name: Espresso Machine
stations.description: Tamp grounds and extract 1:2 ratio espresso.

stations.name: Steam Wand Station
stations.description: Aerate and texture silky microfoam at 60-65°C.

stations.name: Milk Refrigerator
stations.description: Select whole milk, oat milk, or almond milk.

stations.name: Order Pickup Counter
stations.description: Assemble drink and hand off to waiting customer.

levels.title: Milk Steaming & Microfoam Texturing
levels.skill_name: Steam milk to optimal silky microfoam
levels.goal: Steam whole milk to 60–65°C with glossy microfoam suitable for latte art
levels.instruction: Walk over to the Steam Wand Station (top right counter) and press [SPACE] to purge, texture, and shut off at 62°C.
customerProfiles: Flat white enthusiast who inspects foam density and temperature
successConditions: Milk temperature finishes strictly between 60°C and 65°C
Velvety wet-paint microfoam texture with zero large bubbles
Steam wand wiped and purged immediately after steaming
steps: Walk to the Steam Wand Station
Purge steam wand for 1 second to clear moisture
Submerge tip 1cm, tilt pitcher 15° for rolling vortex
Shut off valve at 60-65°C and wipe wand clean

levels.title: Dial in Espresso Extraction
levels.skill_name: Calibrate grind size, dose, and extraction ratio
levels.goal: Dose 18g and extract a 36g double shot in 28 seconds with rich golden crema
levels.instruction: First visit the Conical Grinder to dose 18g, then move to the Espresso Machine to lock portafilter and extract 36g.
customerProfiles: Espresso purist sensitive to under-extracted sourness or over-extracted bitterness
successConditions: Thick hazelnut crema without pale blonding or channeling
steps: Dose exactly 18.0g of coffee at the Grinder Station
Tamp firmly with 15kg pressure and lock into Grouphead
Engage 9-bar pump and stop extraction precisely at 36g

levels.title: Handle Milk Stockout & Order Substitution
levels.skill_name: Resolve unavailable supplies with clear customer communication
levels.goal: Verify oat milk shortage in fridge, offer almond alternative, and secure customer confirmation
levels.instruction: Check the Milk Refrigerator to confirm oat milk stockout (0 cartons), then walk to the Pickup Counter to offer fresh almond milk.
customerProfiles: Busy morning commuter with dietary preference willing to accept alternative if offered kindly
successConditions: Customer explicitly confirms acceptable alternative before preparation
steps: Inspect Milk Refrigerator and record 0 cartons of oat milk
Approach customer at counter: explain shortage politely
Offer organic almond milk alternative and await agreement

levels.title: Multi-Order Barista Rush Prioritization
levels.skill_name: Parallel workflow and ticket sequencing during peak morning rush
levels.goal: Queue and prepare 3 concurrent espresso tickets in under 120 seconds while keeping stations clean
levels.instruction: Visit Grinder, Steamer, and Pickup Counter in rapid sequence to dispatch Americano, Flat White, and Cortado.
customerProfiles: Queue of 3 office workers ordering Americano, Latte, and Cortado
successConditions: All 3 drinks served at peak temperature within 120 seconds
Bar station maintained clean and wiped between tickets
steps: Sequence tickets: Americano (hot water first), Cortado, then Latte
Extract shot 1 while steaming milk for drink 2
Assemble drinks, wipe steam wand, and hand off with ticket numbers
checks: All drinks served hot and fresh
